mapper.insert: INSERT INTO festival(title, season, content) VALUES (#{title}, #{season}, #{content})
mapper.select:
SELECT f.id, f.title, f.season, f.content, i.img_url, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM festival f LEFT JOIN image i ON f.id = i.owner_id AND i.type = 'FESTIVAL' AND i.rep_img_yn = 'Y' WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
AND f.season = #{season}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM festival WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND season = #{season}

SELECT f.id, f.title, f.season, f.content, i.img_url, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM festival f LEFT JOIN image i ON f.id = i.owner_id AND i.type = 'FESTIVAL' AND i.rep_img_yn = 'Y' WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
